integrity: Exact stochastic proof and same-model finite CTMC/spectral checks; independent audit has not been performed; historical priority is bounded by the available primary-source review.
scientific_limitations: Single initially infectious hub on a star, with permanently available susceptible leaves, exponential recovery, exponential stationary contact switching, fixed strictly positive rates; comparison of shared hub contact with independent links. No general-network threshold or non-Markovian renewal extension is established. The binomial-mixture convex-order property is prior generic mathematics; novelty is claimed only for the exact quarantine atom and separated all-neighbor degree exponents.
title: A quarantine atom and unequal complete-transmission exponents on an epidemic star
